def add_sort_method(self, sort_method, label2_mask=None):
        """A wrapper for `xbmcplugin.addSortMethod()
        <http://mirrors.xbmc.org/docs/python-docs/xbmcplugin.html#-addSortMethod>`_.
        You can use ``dir(xbmcswift2.SortMethod)`` to list all available sort
        methods.

        :param sort_method: A valid sort method. You can provided the constant
                            from xbmcplugin, an attribute of SortMethod, or a
                            string name. For instance, the following method
                            calls are all equivalent:

                            * ``plugin.add_sort_method(xbmcplugin.SORT_METHOD_TITLE)``
                            * ``plugin.add_sort_metohd(SortMethod.TITLE)``
                            * ``plugin.add_sort_method('title')``
        :param label2_mask: A mask pattern for label2. See the `XBMC
                            documentation
                            <http://mirrors.xbmc.org/docs/python-docs/xbmcplugin.html#-addSortMethod>`_
                            for more information.
        """
        instance of xbmcswift2.SortMethod
                                    or the string representation of the constant.
                :type sort_method: int, str, xbmcswift2.SortMethod
                :param label2_mask: A mask of sort methods to be applied to the second
                                    label of the list item.
                :type label2_mask: int, xbmcswift2.SortMethod

                :return: None

                Example::

                    # Sort by title
                    add_sort_method(xbmcplugin.SORT_METHOD_LABEL)
                    # Sort by title, then by year
                    add_sort_method(xbmcplugin.SORT_METHOD_LABEL, xbmcplugin.SORT_METHOD_VIDEO_YEAR)
                    # Sort by title, then by year, then by rating
                    add_sort_method(xbmcplugin.SORT_METHOD_LABEL, xbmcplugin.SORT_METHOD_VIDEO_YEAR, xbmcplugin.SORT_METHOD_VIDEO_RATING)
                    # Sort by title, then by year, then by rating, then by genre
                    add_sort_method(xbmcplugin.SORT_METHOD_LABEL, xbmcplugin.SORT_METHOD_VIDEO_YEAR, xbmcplugin.SORT_METHOD_VIDEO_RATING, xbmcplugin.SORT_METHOD_GENRE)
                """
                if isinstance(sort_method, SortMethod):
                    sort_method = sort_method.value
                elif isinstance(sort_method, str):
                    sort_method = getattr(xbmcplugin, sort_method)
                elif not isinstance(sort_method, int):
                    raise ValueError("sort_method must be an int, str or instance of xbmcswift2.SortMethod")

                if label2_mask:
                    if isinstance(label2_mask, SortMethod):
                        label2_mask = label2_mask.value
